unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does the third paragraph mainly tell us?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根拆分: para (在旁边) + graph (写) -> 写作中独立的一节就是段落 (paragraph)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: If you love adventure, you should try paragliding in the mountains.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 如果你热爱冒险，你应该去山里尝试一下滑翔伞运动。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: para-(降落伞) + gliding(滑翔) -> 滑翔伞运动

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: make polite requests and ask for permission.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 每(per)次任务(mission)都需要允许。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Circle the phrases that Ann and Thando use to describe their personalities...
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：person（人）+ al（形容词后缀）+ ity（名词后缀）= 个性，性格。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Confucius is one of the most famous ancient Chinese philosophers.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 孔子是中国古代最著名的哲学家之一。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: philo(爱) + sopher(智慧) -> 爱智慧的人 -> 哲学家

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: People might decide they are going to take up photography.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: photo（照片）+ graphy（学科/艺术）

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can you play ping-pong?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 拟声词：ping和pong就是乒乓球击打桌面时发出的“乒”和“乓”的声音。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Fresh pineapple tastes sweet and slightly sour.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 新鲜的菠萝吃起来酸甜可口。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pine(松树) + apple(苹果) -> 长得像松果的苹果 -> 菠萝

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They lost all their personal possessions in the big fire.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他们在场大火中失去了所有的个人财产。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: possess(拥有) + -ion(名词) + -s(复数) -> 拥有的物品 -> 个人财产

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This course offers students practical skills for future jobs.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这门课程为学生提供未来工作的实际技能。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: practice(练习、实践) + -al(形容词后缀) -> 实际的、务实的

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Hard work is often a strong predictor of future success.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 努力工作往往是未来成功的强有力预示物。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: predict(预言、预测) + -or(……之物/人) -> 预测的根据或预示物

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What are your predictions about the future?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pre(提前) + dict(说) + ion(名词后缀) -> 提前说出未来的事，即预测。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Do you have any personal preference for tea or coffee?
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 你对茶还是咖啡有什么个人偏爱吗？
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: prefer(更喜欢) + -ence(名词后缀) -> 更喜欢的事情 -> 偏爱

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We are making careful preparation for the final exams.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们正在为期末考试做精心的准备。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: prepare(准备) + -ation(名词后缀) -> 准备工作

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She received professional training in dancing from an early age.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她从小就接受了专业的舞蹈训练。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: profession(职业) + -al(形容词) -> 职业水平的 -> 专业的

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Listening to tapes can help you improve your English pronunciation.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 听录音带可以帮助你提高英语发音。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pronounce(发音)的变形 + -ation -> 发音

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Environmental protection is everybody's responsibility.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 环境保护是每个人的责任。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: protect(保护) + -ion(名词后缀) -> 保护

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Pay attention to your grammar and punctuation when writing essays.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 写文章时要注意你的语法和标点符号。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: punctuate(加标点) + -ion(名词) -> 标点符号

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A sudden rainstorm caught us on our way home.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 一场突如其来的暴风雨在回家的路上袭击了我们。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: rain(雨) + storm(风暴) -> 暴风雨

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We need to set realistic goals that we can actually achieve.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们需要设定能够真正实现的现实目标。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: reality(现实) + -istic(形容词后缀) -> 现实的、切合实际的

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 合理的，公平的，可以接受的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Do you think the tips are reasonable?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: reason(理由) + able(能……的) = 有道理的，合理的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The hotel receptionist greeted us warmly upon our arrival.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们到达时，酒店前台接待员热情地迎接了我们。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: reception(接待处) + -ist(人) -> 负责接待的人 -> 接待员

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Recognise text type
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：rec（反复）+ ogn（知道）+ ise → 反复核对终于认出来了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 推荐，建议，介绍，使受欢迎
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My adviser recommended that I should sign up for advanced literature.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：re（重新）+ commend（称赞）-> 再次称赞，即推荐。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Paper and plastic recycling helps protect our environment.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 纸张和塑料的回收利用有助于保护我们的环境。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: re-(重新) + cycle(循环) + -ing -> 循环利用

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Language learning often requires a lot of listening and repetition.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 语言学习通常需要大量的听力和重复。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: repeat(重复)的名词形式 -> 重复

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The dove is a bird that represents peace.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: re-(再次/代) + present(呈现) -> 代表、象征

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The local reservoir provides drinking water for the whole city.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 当地的水库为整个城市提供饮用水。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 源自法语，词根类似reserve(储备) -> 储存水的地方 -> 水库
